product.name: Tumult Hype 4
product.description: A software application for creating animated and interactive HTML5 content without coding, compatible across desktops and mobile devices.

product.name: Tumult Hype Professional (Hype Pro)
product.description: An in-app upgrade to Tumult Hype 4 that adds features like responsive layouts, physics simulation, and reusable symbols for enhanced design capabilities.

product.name: Whisk
product.description: An HTML and PHP editor with live preview that updates in real time as code is written.

product.name: Reflect
product.description: A mobile app for quickly previewing and testing Tumult Hype or Whisk documents on iOS devices.
